rendered:
The paper says serum samples were collected from three enrolled subjects[1]. These subjects were septic patients with confirmed E. coli infection, septic patients with confirmed E. faecium infection, and healthy volunteers serving as the control[2].

So the paper reports this number of enrolled subjects in total, not a number of patients. The most likely reading is that each group had a single subject, which would mean the septic patients numbered the E. coli case plus the E. faecium case, and the third person was a healthy control. However, the paper uses plural nouns for each group and never states a separate patient count, so this is an inference. Each serum sample was measured repeatedly. The multiple points in the LDA plot (Fig. 5[3]c) are technical replicates[4], not additional patients. The full experimental procedures are said to be in the Supporting Information, which is not part of this document.
